title: Knin e-Visitor tourism data and analysis, 2016-2026: data, code, figures and manuscript
description: Monthly e-Visitor records of tourist arrivals and overnight stays in the Town of Knin, Croatia (January 2016 - September 2026) by country of origin, together with the Python code, figures, tables and manuscript of the paper 'From transit stop to destination? A decade of e-Visitor data on tourism in Knin, Croatia'. Includes the comparison series for Sibenik-Knin County and Croatia from the Croatian Bureau of Statistics (PxWeb table BS_TU12). Raw e-Visitor exports are published with the permission of the Tourist Board of the Town of Knin. Code is released under the MIT licence; data and figures under CC BY 4.0.
